From Kyushu or Okinawa.traitNarrativeEffects: Grew up in Kyushu (Fukuoka, Kumamoto, Kagoshima, Nagasaki, Oita or an outlying island) or Okinawa, player's pick; default Fukuoka. How Musutafu and Tokyo treat them: the accent marks them southern; Kyushu folk are assumed loud, stubborn, hard-drinking, Okinawans easygoing and asked about beaches, fondly or condescendingly. Musutafu winters chill Okinawans. A southern typhoon or villain attack means anxious calls home. Who they know: family, dojo mates, a fisherman or diving instructor, island relatives, a neighborhood expecting them at festivals. Local knowledge: typhoons, sea swimming, boats, Kagoshima's volcanic ash, hot springs, food; karate began in Okinawa; kendo and judo halls fill Kyushu towns. Speech: strong dialect; show words and rhythm, not phonetic spelling. Fukuoka: 'bari' (very), '-to?' questions, '-ken' reasons; Kagoshima speech stumps other Japanese. Okinawa: 'haisai'/'haitai' hi, 'mensoore' welcome, 'nankurunaisa' it'll work out, 'chibariyo' cheer.
